purpose: Make a formal request for someone’s action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
お + Vます stem + 願う; ご + Sino-Japanese N + 願う
Please fill out the application form.
formation: お + Vます stem + 願う; ご + Sino-Japanese N + 願う
restrictions: Commonly ends 願います or 願えますか and uses established honorific forms.
mistake: Do not attach お mechanically to every verb or foreign word.
